I'm pleased to be leading the research and oral history interviews for this project, particularly as Vivability prepares to give this historic Bathurst building a new purpose. If you have a personal connection to the former Ambulance Station, or know someone who may have memories or stories to share, I'd love to hear from you. Built with funds raised by the local community and located in the heart of the CBD, it is a building that generations of Bathurst residents know and value. This project is an opportunity to capture the personal stories behind that history. Please contact me at [email redacted], or share this post with someone who may have a story to tell. This project is supported by Create NSW's Local History Grants Program, a devolved funding program administered by The Royal Australian Historical Society on behalf of the NSW Government. us-veterans-veterans-day-collectors-edit.headline: U.S. Veterans - Veterans Day Collector's Edition Feature
us-veterans-veterans-day-collectors-edit.author: Paul E. McFadden
us-veterans-veterans-day-collectors-edit.core: Posted in last 7 days U.S. Veterans - Veterans Day Collector's Edition Feature The uniform may come off. The story of service never stops being written. For many veterans, military service represents a defining chapter of their lives. But it is rarely the final chapter. The lessons continue. The experiences shape us. And the commitment to serve often finds new expression in the lives we build afterward. I'm honored to share that I'll be featured in an upcoming Veterans Day publication celebrating America's military veterans. My friend and publisher, Ken “Dr. Smiley” Rochon, is preparing to release: KEEP SMILING: PATRIOTISM HAPPENS Veterans Edition | Collector's Edition 🇺🇸 Launching November 11, 2026. The publication celebrates military service through a yearlong tribute recognizing veterans alongside significant moments in American history. My personal feature appears on May 8, commemorating V-E Day. As a U.S. Navy Reserve veteran and Kings Point Alumni, I'm grateful to be included. But this recognition has me thinking about something much larger. How many extraordinary veterans are quietly living among us whose stories have never been told? Consider the veterans within our professional networks. Some have become executives and entrepreneurs. Others are educators, healthcare professionals, mentors, community leaders, and advocates. Some continue to serve in ways that will never appear on a résumé or professional profile. And many carry experiences, perspectives, and lessons that could profoundly influence the next generation. Their contributions cannot always be measured by a title, position, or professional accomplishment. Because service is not simply something we have done. For many, it becomes part of who we are. That is why I'm sharing this initiative. With more than 12,000+ connections here on LinkedIn, I believe there are remarkable veterans within this community whose stories deserve recognition. And I'd like to help bring some of those stories forward. To my fellow veterans: If you've served, I'd love to hear from you. To my civilian colleagues: Is there a veteran you admire whose story deserves a larger platform? I'd welcome the opportunity to connect interested individuals with Ken to learn more about this initiative and potential opportunities for recognition. Comment “VETERAN” below or message me privately. And if there's a veteran in your network who should see this invitation, please share it with them. Because sometimes the greatest expression of gratitude is not simply thanking someone for their service. It's making sure their story is remembered. Their service mattered. Their experience matters. And their legacy is still being written. 🇺🇸 #Veterans #VeteransDay2026 #MilitaryLeadership #PatriotismHappens

americans-personal-stories-submission-am.core: Posted in last 7 days Americans - Personal Stories Submission - American People Book The American People Book I want to hear your stories! No matter what they are. Feel free to share names, or remain anonymous. But all stories will be added into this book and published for the public. We should not have to hide our truth. Even if it's your whole life story, or the story of a friend, past relative, or even history that they refuse to teach about. I want it all. So here are a few questions for you to get thinking first. When did this happen? What happened? How did the systems we set up fail you? In a perfect world, what would be different? What do we (Americans) gain by sharing this information? What do you choose to be called as? (Your real name, anonymous, pen names, etc.) Where did this happen? How long did these things occur for? You can tell your story however you wish. But let these questions help guide your writing. I know it's not easy to think back on these things. But do it for our future. Every word means something. "Actions speak louder than words," but what if our words are our only action we have left to use? Tell me your story.

european-retailers-and-analysts-confecti.core: Posted in last 7 days European Retailers & Analysts - Confectionery Sales After GLP-1s Confectionery is a stalwart category of both the supermarket and convenience sectors. Famously impervious to crisis, many of its boosters say troubled times actually boost sales as people seek an affordable treat. To find out whether this is still the case, I’ve been commissioned by European Supermarket Magazine to analyse how chocolate and sweet sales have fared over the last year in European retail, and where they are heading. I’m looking to answer the following questions: - How have GLP-1 medicines affected confectionery sales? - Are people taking a greater interest in health, and seeking out good nutrients while avoiding sugary snacks? - Which chocolate and sweets are increasing their sales, and which are on the downward slope? - How are suppliers continuing to adapt to financial pressures, including via shrinkflation? - What flavour or format trends are we seeing? I’m looking to speak to retailers, analysts and suppliers, as well as anyone else with an interest in confectionery. Please get in touch with written comments or to arrange a Zoom interview. European Supermarket Magazine

dubai-restaurant-operators-embed-sustain.core: Posted in last 7 days Dubai Restaurant Operators - Embed Sustainability In Business When Omar Shihab came to me with his plan for this piece, I knew it was going to make some noise. Here was someone who'd spent years pushing Dubai’s restaurant industry to take sustainability seriously, championing local produce and helping BOCA earn a Michelin Green Star, saying it was time to rethink it all... Talk about a head turner. Omar could talk about this all day, and I felt privileged that he trusted me to help bring it to Caterer Middle East. It’s also exactly why I came back to Caterer: to be involved in journalism that moves the conversation on and gets people talking about important issues in our industry. How do we make sustainability part of the way businesses are built and run, rather than a buzzword or another box to tick? How does it become part of everyday commercial decisions? There’s plenty more to explore here. I’ll be working on more pieces around this, and will be reaching out to everyone in the industry with something to say on the subject - and hearing more from Omar, no doubt. Read the full piece here 👇 https://lnkd.in/dqTYGgXY Caterer Middle East
